findings.reason: PhysicalKSBoxPointwiseData means ContDiffOn real infinity, real AnalyticOnNhd and true recursively defined fderiv coordinate-word bounds for the same actual normalized physical KS pullback on the open box of halfwidth 1/512.

The representative already supplied by the physical graph is locally Lipschitz, hence continuous. Each KS lift and physical spectator inverse is continuous. The weak-profile smooth representative agrees pointwise with this original continuous base on the open box by volume.eqOn_open_of_ae_eq. Actual fderiv words are transferred by equality on an open neighborhood.

The inner box halfwidth is 1/512, so each seven-dimensional tensor side length is 1/256 and the point-evaluation product constant is (257/16)^7. It lies inside the smooth cutoff plateau halfwidth 3/1024 and profile norm region halfwidth 1/256; the cutoff support remains inside the weak derivative region halfwidth 1/128.

The actual profile embedding uses order k+11. The binomial estimate (k+11)! <= 2^(k+11)*k!*11! yields rate Q=6144*C*A and amplitude (257/16)^7*[12*C*A*(F0+498*sqrt(W))]*Q^11*11!, with C=commonKSBoxFactorialConstant M. Nonnegativity and Q>0 are proved from A>=1, F0>=0 and C>=1.

Actual coordinate-word bounds for all seven coordinates imply actual iterated Frechet operator bounds with factor 7^k. The existing factorial Frechet series theorem gives real analyticity on the open region using a positive interior margin. No analyticity assumption is introduced in the physical pointwise wrappers.

The same C_H,M,A,u,L,R and source/H12 amplitudes from the weighted endpoint are retained before all spin, scale, chart and center quantifiers. The normalized difference, nuclear and pair maps and inverse physical spectator permutations are unchanged.

The actual normalized weak-H2-domain ground vector, eigen-equation, spectral infimum equality, spectrum membership/lower bound and normalized symmetric spatial singlet amplitude are identical to the reviewed weighted ground package. The explicit charge assumptions remain Z>0 and 32<9*Z^2.
